title: The Ten Plagues of Egypt
description: God sends ten plagues upon Egypt—blood, frogs, gnats, flies, pestilence, boils, hail, locusts, darkness, and the warning of the death of the firstborn—to force Pharaoh to let the Israelites go. Despite the plagues, Pharaoh repeatedly hardens his heart.

versions.title: The Ten Plagues of Egypt
versions.description: God sends ten plagues upon Egypt to force Pharaoh to release the Israelites.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The end of the story in 12:36 overlaps with the existing 'Passover and Exodus' (12:1-42). It could be considered ending at 12:30 to avoid overlap, but the plague narrative naturally includes the tenth plague.

versions.reason: [minor] references: The reference 7:14-11:10 fully covers the first nine plagues and the announcement of the tenth. The actual execution of the tenth plague (the death of the firstborn) occurs in chapter 12, but it is linked to the Passover story which is covered separately. The delimitation is reasonable.; [minor] description: The description correctly lists all ten plagues and aligns with the biblical text. The tenth plague (death of the firstborn) is announced in chapter 11 but carried out in chapter 12, which the description handles appropriately.
